focus: 今天的重點：看天氣圖說 windy、聽位置 on、What color…?、Can you…?、聽老師指示和自我介紹找細節、讀作息表、現在進行式 is + -ing、用 but 連接。
notes: 聽力第 4 題：Can you…? 要用 Yes, I can. 或 No, I can't. 回答，不能用 No, I don't.。在家可以問 Kyro：Can you swim? 讓他用 can 回答。
閱讀段落填空第 1 格：說「小狗的名字」要用 Its（它的），不是 It；Its 後面接名字 name。
寫作第 1 題：改成「正在做」要寫 is + 動詞-ing：Kyro is drawing a cat。常見錯誤是漏掉 is，或 draw 忘了加 -ing。

listen.q: How is the weather this afternoon?
listen.why: 圖上在颳風：windy（風很大）。sunny 是晴天，snowy 是下雪。
綠色的書放在桌子上面：on the table。under 是下面，next to 是旁邊。

talk: What color is your lunch box, Kyro?
listen.why: What color 問「什麼顏色」，要回答顏色：It's blue（藍色）。On my desk 是地點。

talk: Can you play the piano, Kyro?
listen.why: Can you…? 問「你會不會」，要用 can 回答：Yes, I can.（我會）。No, I don't 要配 Do you 問句。

talk: Kyro, let's play basketball after school.
Sorry, Kane. I have swimming class today.
listen.why: Kyro 說 I have swimming class today：他今天有游泳課，所以明天才打籃球。

talk: Kyro, we can take the bus to the zoo.
Can we take the train, Mom?
listen.q: How will they go to the zoo?
listen.why: Kyro 問可不可以搭火車，媽媽說 OK：他們搭火車（by train）去動物園。

talk: Good morning, class. We will plant flowers today. Please bring a cup from home. Do not bring a ball. Put on your hat. It is sunny.
listen.q: What should the children bring from home?
listen.why: 老師說 Please bring a cup from home：要從家裡帶一個杯子來種花。球不要帶。

talk: Hi, I am Tom. I am Kane's friend. I am nine years old. I like animals. I have a bird at home. It is yellow and small. It can sing every morning.
listen.why: Tom 說 I have a bird at home：他家有一隻黃色的小鳥，每天早上會唱歌。

vocab.stem: I want to write my name. Where is my ____?
A ____ makes good food in the kitchen.
vocab.why: 在廚房做好吃食物的人是廚師：cook，是學校 LA 的單字。nurse 是護士。

vocab.stem: My little sister ____ ride a bike now.
vocab.why: 妹妹現在「會」騎腳踏車：can ride。can 後面接動詞原形 ride。

cloze.passage: Kyro has a little dog. {1} name is Lucky. Lucky likes to run in the park. One day, Lucky sees a big ball {2} a tree. He runs to the tree and gets it. Kyro is very happy.

items.why: 說「牠的」名字要用 Its：Its name is Lucky。It 是「牠」，不能接 name。
球在樹的下面：under a tree。

text.intro: 讀下面 Kyro 星期二的作息表，回答三個問題。
text.title: Kyro's Tuesday

items.stem: What time is Kyro's swimming class?
How does Kyro go to school?
items.why: 8:00 Go to school by bus：Kyro 搭公車上學。

items.stem: What does Kyro do at six-thirty?
items.why: 6:30 Dinner at home：六點半在家吃晚餐。

write.instr: 改成「正在⋯⋯」的句子（現在進行式）。
near: 前面要加 is：Kyro is drawing。
Kyro 是一個人，要用 is。

write.instr: 用 but 把兩個句子合成一句。
accept: my bag is big but my cup is small
write.model: My bag is big, but my cup is small.
near: 一個大、一個小，意思相反，用 but，不是 and。
意思相反，用 but，不是 or。
hints: 大和小意思相反，用 but 連起來。
My bag is big, ___ my cup is small.

write.instr: 依照順序點字卡，排成一句話。
hints: 大寫字母開頭的字放第一個，有句點的字放最後。
數一數有 5 朵花：five；貓在椅子上：chair。
